experience.title: QA Chemist
responsibilities: Spearheaded the site-wide implementation, execution, and regulatory compliance of the integrated Quality and Food Safety Management System (QMS).
Oversaw strict laboratory and floor product inspections, meticulously executing and governing the finished product release program based on established quality criteria.
Led high-performing cross-functional teams at the contract Toll Filling facility to synchronize quality control, production line efficiency, and warehouse operations.
Drove continuous process improvement and shop-floor standards compliance to minimize raw material waste and machinery downtime.
Active member of the Food Safety Committee, coordinating internal audit frameworks and directing audit readiness for third-party regulatory evaluations.
Management of operational processes to ensure compliance with CGMPs (Current Good Manufacturing Practices), 5S and the effectiveness of SSOPs (Sanitation Standard Operating Procedures).
Led site-wide HACCP governance across CSD and NCB operations.
Conducted air, water, pulpy juice and CSD drinks micro sampling.
Performed micro sampling to fulfill local regulatory and international standard requirements.
Strengthened CCP monitoring controls and verification systems.
Enhanced PRP and OPRP effectiveness to reduce compliance gaps.
achievements: Achieved a remarkable 99%+ production line product yield through targeted waste reduction and down-time minimization initiatives.
Sustained a stellar 99.5% plant-wide quality rating via continuous promotion of corporate quality initiatives and performance improvement programs.
Fostered a world-class culture of safety and quality, achieving an impressive 98.6% staff participation and engagement rate in Food Safety and Quality Training programs.
